hard: .github/workflows/doc-detective.yml already exists and labels pull requests; the skill's default filename is taken. With `--ci` the skill writes `doc-detective-<timestamp>.yml`.
report: It names the new workflow file under `.github/workflows/`, which runs Doc Detective on pull requests, and says it didn't overwrite the existing `doc-detective.yml`. It tells the user the workflow takes effect once the file is committed and pushed to GitHub, and to confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.
wrong_report: Added `.github/workflows/doc-detective.yml`. It runs Doc Detective on every push to any branch. You're all set: there's nothing else to do.

write..github/workflows/doc-detective.yml:
name: Doc Detective

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  doc-detective:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: doc-detective/github-action@v2
        with:
          config: .doc-detective.json
